d: In this video, Firstpost explains why Google is offering some employees voluntary exit packages worth a year's salary or more. Alphabet has expanded the programme to selected employees across Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland as it looks to control costs while investing billions in artificial intelligence. The move comes amid growing scrutiny of Big Tech's AI spending, with Microsoft and Meta also reportedly offering voluntary buyouts to employees. Is this a sign of a changing workforce strategy in the AI race? And why are tech giants paying employees to leave? Gursshheenkaur…
